description: Checks database migrations for data loss, table locks, and deploy problems. Returns every finding with what happens, why, and a safe alternative. Run it after writing or changing a migration. Without files, it checks the migrations configured for the project, or every migrations folder.

changedSince.description: A git ref, such as origin/main. Checks only migrations added or changed since the branch left it.

dialect.description: The database. Default: the config, or postgres.

files.description: Migration files or globs, relative to projectDir, such as ["src/migrations/1727200000000-AddEmail.ts"].

postgresVersion.description: The PostgreSQL major version. Default: the config, or 16.

projectDir.description: Absolute path of the project root, where package.json is. Default: the directory the server started in.

name: check_migrations
title: Check migrations
